lines.en: label mayaspring5:
scene mayaeveryoneshrine1
Maya Makinami never thought she’d enjoy life as a cuck. But she was kind of almost starting to except for all of the parts where she wasn’t. Which was most of them.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 从没想过自己会享受当王八的生活。但她多少有点开始享受了——除了那些她并没有享受的部分。而那些占了大多数。

lines.en: Regardless, she stood there in all of her cucky glory with a cucky broom in her cucky hands and thought to herself - {i}”What am I going to eat for dinner?”{/i}
lines.zh: 无论如何，她就这么站在那儿，带着她绿帽子般的荣耀，手里握着她绿帽子般的扫帚，心想——"{i}晚饭吃什么呢？{/i}"

lines.en: But then {i}after{/i} that, she thought - {i}”Can this state of being, so dissimilar from the life I once envisioned for myself, truly become something I can grow to appreciate and, perhaps, even love? The same way I love him?”{/i}
lines.zh: 但{i}随后{/i}她又想——"{i}这种与我曾经为自己设想的人生截然不同的状态，真的能变成我可以慢慢欣赏、甚至去爱的东西吗？就像我爱他那样？{/i}"

lines.en: The latter thought was significantly more complicated than the first.
lines.zh: 后一个念头远比前一个复杂。

lines.en: So complicated, in fact, that as the hands of The Millennium Clock ticked incessantly back and forth between The Martyr and The Old Clown, she was still, after all this time, incapable of coming up with an answer.
lines.zh: 复杂到，当千年钟的指针在殉道者与老丑角之间来回不停地滴答时，她过了这么久，依然想不出答案。

lines.en: But it was an answer she {i}must{/i} arrive at for any of this to matter at all, you see.
lines.zh: 但你也看到了，她{i}必须{/i}得出一个答案，否则这一切都毫无意义。

lines.en: She was important.
lines.zh: 她很重要。

lines.en: Far more important than us. Than those who watch from the tiled floors in the National Museum of Scotland in great awe of the bell who sits atop The Spire, {i}wanting{/i} to touch it, but knowing they never will.
lines.zh: 远比我们重要。比那些从苏格兰国家博物馆的地砖上仰望的人重要——他们满怀敬畏地看着钟楼顶端的那口钟，{i}想{/i}要触碰它，却知道自己永远也碰不到。

lines.en: {size=-2}But what if, on some lazy Sunday, a fit of madness consumed this rhetorical person? And what if that person, naked as the day they were born, {i}sprinted{/i} through the halls that house time itself and destroyed it all?{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}可是，如果在某个慵懒的周日，一阵疯狂攫住了这个修辞意义上的人呢？如果这个人赤身裸体、如同初生，{i}飞奔{/i}过那些容纳时间本身的厅堂，把一切都毁掉呢？{/size}

lines.en: What if they made it to the clock, felt the power of God course through them like It were the first sip of a Five Hour Energy, then surpassed human limits and destroyed the destruction of man?
lines.zh: 如果他们跑到了那口钟前，感受到上帝的力量如同一瓶 Five Hour Energy 的第一口般流遍全身，然后超越了人类的极限，毁掉了人类所造的毁灭呢？

lines.en: I think that, in such an oddly specific and mildly irreverent scenario, we’d have a real shot at eclectic, blissful anarchy in this little anthill of ours.
lines.zh: 我想，在这样一个具体得离奇、又略带不敬的情境里，我们这个小小的蚁丘里倒真有可能迎来一场兼收并蓄、极乐的无政府状态。

lines.en: {size=-4}But, as it stands, the way we are is Pandora’s Box. And despite the Hunger, Madness, and Grief, we’re all just Intellectuals and Hermits on the way to War Camps to partake in Forced Labor in the name of today’s Holocaust.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}但就目前而言，我们现在的样子就是潘多拉的盒子。而尽管有饥饿、疯狂与悲伤，我们不过都是知识分子与隐者，正走在通往战争营的路上，要以今日的大屠杀之名去从事强制劳动。{/size}

lines.en: This War, Invalid as it may seem, has its bright spots though.
lines.zh: 不过这场战争——尽管看上去是无效的——也有它的亮点。

lines.en: {size=-5}The Belfry {i}shines{/i} beneath The Requiem, bathing us in awe, in solitude, in want of something like this to extend beyond the reaches of what governs us and compel us to finish our opening narrations so that a bunch of girls in cute outfits can show up and bother the subject of today’s troubles.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}钟楼在安魂曲之下{i}闪耀{/i}，将我们沐浴在敬畏、孤独，以及对某种事物的渴望里——渴望它能延伸到那统治我们的东西之外，并驱使我们去完成开场旁白，好让一群穿着可爱衣服的女孩登场，来烦扰今日苦难的主角。{/size}

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine2
Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: It wouldn’t really be {i}bothersome{/i} at all.
lines.zh: 那其实一点也不{i}烦人{/i}。

lines.en: For despite the loneliness of the shrine maiden, there was also a painful yearning.
lines.zh: 因为尽管巫女是孤独的，其中也伴随着一种痛苦的渴望。

lines.en: The same kind that used to wish for windows just to realize that, should those windows exist, all she’d see is darkness. Even three stories up.
lines.zh: 正是那种曾经盼望窗户的渴望——只为意识到，即便那些窗户真的存在，她能看见的也只有黑暗。哪怕是在三层楼那么高的地方。

lines.en: That was all she knew before the light found her.
lines.zh: 在光找到她之前，那就是她所知道的全部。

lines.en: And, like clockwork, that was also all {i}he{/i} knew before the light found {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: 而像钟表机械一样，在光找到{i}他{/i}之前，那也是{i}他{/i}所知道的全部。

lines.en: : Okay, everyone! Single file line! We need to look as cool as possible so that Maya welcomes us with open arms.
lines.zh: : 好了，各位！排成一列！我们要尽可能看起来酷一点，好让 Maya 张开双臂欢迎我们。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine3
: Huh? What’s-
lines.zh: : 哈？什么——

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine4
: Oh, absolutely fucking not.
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对他妈的不行。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine5
: Well, if it isn’t everyone’s favorite miko in the flesh! Strike a pose, gang. And say something cool so it looks like we belong here!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这不是大家最喜欢的巫女本人吗！摆个造型，伙伴们。再说点酷的话，好显得我们是这儿的人！

lines.en: : Sup. Come here often?
lines.zh: : 哟。常来这儿？

lines.en: : So this is what it’s like here. Interesting. It feels less oppressive and far more serene than I expected.
lines.zh: : 原来这儿是这个样子。有意思。比我预想的要少一些压抑，多了几分宁静。

lines.en: : Yumi? Are you-
lines.zh: : Yumi？你是——

lines.en: : Shut the fuck up, Four Eyes. Just...completely ignore that I’m even here until all of this embarrassing shit is over and done with.
lines.zh: : 给我闭嘴，四眼。就……等这些丢人的破事全都结束之前，完全当我根本不在这儿。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine6
: Ayane...I don’t know what you think you’re doing, but-
lines.zh: : Ayane……我不知道你以为自己在干什么，但是——

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine7
: You know, it wasn’t all that long ago that a wise woman looked at me and said — “Ayane...One day, if something terrible happens to me, it will be {i}you{/i} who must carry the mantle.”
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，就在不久之前，一位睿智的女性看着我说——"Ayane……有一天，如果有什么可怕的事发生在我身上，那挑起这副担子的人一定是{i}你{/i}。"

lines.en: : “For it is only through teamwork, persistence, acceptance of one another, and an abundance of miko dresses that this world can truly be saved. I love you so much. We’ll be best friends forever.”
lines.zh: : "因为只有通过团队合作、坚持不懈、彼此接纳，以及大量的巫女服，这个世界才能真正被拯救。我好爱你。我们会永远是最好的朋友。"

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine8
: And that wise woman, Maya?...That wise woman was you.
lines.zh: : 而那位睿智的女性，Maya？……那位睿智的女性就是你。

lines.en: : No it fucking wasn’t. No iteration of me would ever say “I love you so much. We’ll be best friends forever.”
lines.zh: : 才他妈不是。我的任何一个版本都不可能说出"我好爱你。我们会永远是最好的朋友"。

lines.en: : You said it with your eyes.
lines.zh: : 你用眼睛说的。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine9
: And I will never forget the look. Because-
lines.zh: : 而我永远不会忘记那个眼神。因为——

lines.en: : Go away! And take everyone else with you! None of you are allowed to be here!
lines.zh: : 走开！把其他人都带上！你们谁都不许在这儿！

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine10
: What do you mean? Of course we are. Shrines are public property protected by the Japanese government.
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？我们当然可以。神社是受日本政府保护的公共财产。

lines.en: : Well, {i}this{/i} one isn’t! And parading a bunch of false shrine maidens here under the guise of volunteers or whatever the fuck this is is just going to make the gods angry!
lines.zh: : {i}这座{/i}可不是！而且带着一堆冒牌巫女在这儿游行，打着志愿者还是什么鬼名号，只会惹怒神明！

lines.en: : But cursing in their very home will not? Also, you don’t even believe in God. You used to tell me all the time between reminding me that we are best friends who will be together forever.
lines.zh: : 可在他们家里说脏话就不会吗？再说，你根本就不信上帝。你以前一边跟我念叨我们是最好的朋友、会永远在一起，一边就是这么跟我说的。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine11
: Does anyone else want those two to date or is it just me?
lines.zh: : 还有别人想让她们俩交往吗，还是只有我？

lines.en: : I think our class would be best if it was just one massive polycule where, each day, we drew a randomized partner out of a hat and started anew the following morning.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们班最好变成一个巨大的多角关系，每天早上从帽子里随机抽一个伴侣，第二天早上再重来。

lines.en: : The fuck are we even doing here again? I blacked out the second Blondie told me how much she’d pay me to put on this stupid fucking dress.
lines.zh: : 我们到底他妈的来这儿干嘛？金发女一说给我多少钱让我穿上这条蠢得要死的裙子，我就断片了。

lines.en: : Some sort of meeting she used to do before the first iteration of Maya was wiped from existence. I was never informed as to why the shouzoku was necessary, though.
lines.zh: : 是她在第一版 Maya 被从存在中抹去之前常做的某种集会。不过从来没人告诉过我为什么非得穿这套装束。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine12
: Wait, wiped from existence? The heck you talkin’ about with this “wiped from existence” nonsense? Sensei never told me about that.
lines.zh: : 等等，从存在中抹去？你在胡扯什么"从存在中抹去"的鬼话？Sensei 从来没跟我说过这个。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Right, so, despite living in a never-ending loop of our freshman year, we can technically still lose whatever memories we accumulate throughout said loops and wind up back at the starting point. That happened to Maya.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}对，所以，尽管我们活在一个永无止境的高一循环里，从技术上说，我们依然可能失去在这些循环中积累的记忆，然后回到起点。Maya 就遇上了这种事。{/size}

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine13
: What?! Don’t you think that’s something somebody should’ve told me before I started rewriting my outlook on life to be a lot more optimistic?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！难道你不觉得，在我开始把人生观改写得乐观得多之前，应该有人先告诉我这件事吗？！

lines.en: : This changes everything! And I literally {i}just{/i} changed, Makoto! Both literally and figuratively!
lines.zh: : 这改变了一切！而我明明{i}刚刚{/i}才改变过来，Makoto！字面意义上和比喻意义上都是！

lines.en: : You’re going to have to get used to a lot of caveats and information that slips through the cracks from here on out if you want to survive, Uta. That’s just how it is here.
lines.zh: : 如果你想在这儿活下去，Uta，你就得习惯从今往后会有很多附加说明、很多从缝隙里漏掉的信息。这儿就是这样。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine14
: And this “starting point” is where, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么这个"起点"具体是哪儿？

lines.en: : It changes all the time. Just somewhere near the beginning of the school year for the most part.
lines.zh: : 一直在变。大概总在学年开头的某个地方。

lines.en: : And I assume the only memories that are purged are the ones we’ve made during the loops and not those that predate when they began, correct?
lines.zh: : 我猜，被清除的只有我们在循环期间制造的记忆，而不是循环开始之前就有的那些，对吧？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah. Good job.
lines.zh: : 差不多，对。答得好。

lines.en: : This was some sort of ritual then? That Ayane and Maya conducted to try and prevent such a thing from happening with the assistance of this shrine’s deity?
lines.zh: : 那就是某种仪式了？Ayane 和 Maya 主持的，试图借助这座神社的神灵来防止这种事发生？

lines.en: : No. I think Ayane just liked wearing the dress and hanging out with Maya, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 不是。说实话，我觉得 Ayane 只是喜欢穿那条裙子、喜欢跟 Maya 混在一起。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine15
: For the last time, go home!
lines.zh: : 最后说一遍，回家去！

lines.en: : Maya, calm down! We’re not going to bother you! If anything, we’re here to {i}help!{/i} Sweeping this whole place by yourself must get pretty exhausting, right?
lines.zh: : Maya，冷静点！我们不是来烦你的！要说的话，我们是来{i}帮{/i}忙的！你一个人扫完这整个地方一定挺累的吧？

lines.en: : Not really! Nobody ever comes here and I mostly just walk around and internally monologue about how shitty my life is until Sensei shows up and I get to make fun of him instead!
lines.zh: : 一点都不累！根本没人来这儿，我大多时候就是到处走走，在心里独白我的人生有多烂，直到 Sensei 出现，我就可以改成取笑他了！

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine16
: Well, consider today an exciting shake-up of your regular formula then!
lines.zh: : 那就把今天当成对你固定流程的一次激动人心的大改造吧！

lines.en: : It’s like I was saying earlier — if we’re ever going to make it through this, we must do it with the power of {i}friendship.{/i} Right, gang? For it is only with each other’s assistance that we can ever-
lines.zh: : 就像我刚才说的——如果我们真要熬过这一切，就必须借助{i}友谊{/i}的力量。对吧，伙伴们？因为只有借助彼——

lines.en: : Ayane. A word. In {i}private.{/i}
lines.zh: : Ayane。借一步说话。{i}私下{/i}说。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine17
: I’m sorry Maya, but I already have a boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊 Maya，但我已经有男朋友了。

lines.en: : Not that kind of word!
lines.zh: : 不是那种"一步"！

lines.en: : A threesome then? I suppose I’m okay with that. But we must first establish some ground rules and come up with a safe word.
lines.zh: : 那三人行？我倒是可以接受。不过我们得先立几条基本规则，再想个安全词。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine18
: That’s it! Everyone, out!
lines.zh: : 够了！所有人，出去！

lines.en: : Okay, girls — how about we take five and rendezvous when I’m done having a talk with Maya about our upcoming sexual encounter?
lines.zh: : 好的，姑娘们——要不我们先休息五分钟，等我和 Maya 谈完我们即将到来的性 encounter 再集合？

lines.en: scene black

: There will {i}be{/i} no upcoming sexual encounter! And this will take a lot longer than five minutes! That isn’t nearly enough time to chop your corpse into pieces I can easily distribute throughout the shrine grounds!
lines.zh: : 没{i}有{/i}什么即将到来的性 encounter！而且这事儿花的时间会比五分钟长得多！那点时间根本不够我把你的尸体剁成能轻松分散到神社各处的碎块！

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine19
: Now, that’s just mean. I don’t recall the old Maya ever threatening to kill me. She probably did at some point, though.
lines.zh: : 这就太刻薄了。我不记得旧 Maya 曾经威胁过要杀我。不过她大概在某个时点确实干过。

lines.en: : What are you doing?! What is all this about?! I can get in trouble for you being here, you know!
lines.zh: : 你们在干什么？！这到底是怎么回事？！你们在这儿我会惹上麻烦的，你知道吗！

lines.en: : From who? God? I’ve never even seen another shrine maiden here.
lines.zh: : 惹上谁的麻烦？上帝？我在这儿连第二个巫女都没见过。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m not convinced this isn’t just your secret house that you’ve been hiding from everyone for Maya reasons.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我都快要相信这根本就是你为了 Maya 的理由藏着掖着、瞒着所有人的秘密小屋了。

lines.en: : Where did you even get the dresses?!
lines.zh: : 你们到底从哪儿弄来的那些裙子？！

lines.en: : Don Quijote. They have everything there.
lines.zh: : Don Quijote。那儿什么都有。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine20
: Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : Don-don-don, donki! Donki...hōteeee! Boryūmu manten gekiyasu janguru~
lines.zh: : Don-don-don, donki! Donki...hōteeee! Boryūmu manten gekiyasu janguru~

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine21
: AYANE!
lines.zh: : AYANE！

lines.en: : Hi.
: What do you want?! Why are you here?! Do you just get a kick out of pissing me off or something?!
lines.zh: : 你想干什么？！你为什么在这儿？！你就以惹毛我为乐还是怎么的？！

lines.en: : No, I just miss you.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是想你。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine22
: ...What?
: I miss you. And I miss coming here on weekends to hang out and brainstorm and listen to your stories about the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 我想你。我想念每个周末来这儿，一起闲逛、一起头脑风暴、听你讲那些关于世界末日的故事。

lines.en: : {size=-2}And while I understand that it wasn’t {i}you{/i} I was doing all of those things with, it doesn’t change the fact that you still look like her and act like her and get mad at me the same way she did when I’d come here unannounced.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}虽然我明白，我当初做那些事的对象并不是{i}你{/i}，但这改变不了一个事实——你看起来像她，举止像她，而且当我这样不打招呼就跑来时，你生气的样子也跟她一模一样。{/size}

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine23
: We used to joke back then...about what would happen if other girls started getting involved with all of this apocalypse stuff.
lines.zh: : 那时候我们还开玩笑来着……说如果别的姑娘也开始卷进这些末日的事，会怎么样。

lines.en: : How we’d {i}all{/i} wind up as shrine maidens and how clean this place would be with the help of our entire class...
lines.zh: : 说我们最后{i}都会{/i}变成巫女，说有全班同学帮忙这地方会变得多干净……

lines.en: : You hated it back then too. You still thought I was annoying and pushy, but...
lines.zh: : 你那时候也讨厌这个。你照样觉得我又烦又爱push人，不过……

lines.en: : A lot has changed since then. And I thought it would be nice to turn those old jokes into something real. Even if it’s for just...a few minutes before you kick us all out.
lines.zh: : 从那以后变了很多。而我想，把那些老玩笑变成真的，应该会挺好的。哪怕只是……在你把我们全赶出去之前的几分钟。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine24
: I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t know what sort of relationship you have with me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你和我之间算是什么关系。

lines.en: : I don’t know where the Maya {i}I{/i} know starts or...where {i}you{/i} begin. And that’s made it...really hard for me to accept the way things are now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道{i}我{/i}认识的那个 Maya 从哪里开始，又……{i}你{/i}从哪里开始。而这一点让我……很难接受现在的样子。

lines.en: : I know you’ve found some closure with Sensei. And I’m happy for you guys...really.
lines.zh: : 我知道你已经和 Sensei 达成了某种和解。我也为你们高兴……真的。

lines.en: : I never really...{i}got{/i} that, though. So it’s still like my friend is just a new person all of a sudden and...
lines.zh: : 可我从来没真正……{i}得到过{/i}那个。所以对我来说，我的朋友仍然像是突然变成了一个全新的人，而且……

lines.en: : I miss her sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有时候会想她。

lines.en: : And I just thought that maybe, you’d like...miss me too or something. Whether it be subconsciously or...
lines.zh: : 而我只是想，也许，你会……也想我之类的。不管是潜意识里还是……

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I’m just sorry.
lines.zh: : 我只是很抱歉。

lines.en: : I always thought it’d be {i}me{/i} to get sent back if it was either one of us, honestly.
lines.zh: : 说真的，如果非得是{i}我{/i}们俩中的一个被送回去，我一直以为那会是我。

lines.en: : I wasn’t prepared for this. And now I don’t know what I’m supposed to do whenever I’m around you.
lines.zh: : 我对此毫无准备。而现在，每当我在你身边，我都不知道自己该怎么办。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine25
: I want to be there, though. Not just with you, but {i}for{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 可我想陪在那儿。不只是陪着你，而是{i}为了{/i}你。

lines.en: : And if Sensei can find it in himself to love you and look at you as your own person instead of a ghost of the past, then I can too. And I’m sorry it’s taken this long for me to try and do that.
lines.zh: : 而如果 Sensei 都能找到办法去爱你、把你当成你自己而不是过去的幽灵来看待，那我也可以。而我很抱歉，我花了这么久才试着这么做。

lines.en: : You...
: You don’t need to {i}apologize.{/i} And I...can’t really tell you where I {i}begin{/i} either since that’s just...a weird fucking question.
lines.zh: : 你不需要{i}道歉{/i}。而我……也说不清我从哪里{i}开始{/i}，因为那只是个…… weird 得要命的问题。

lines.en: : It’s not like...we {i}aren’t{/i} friends, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 又{i}不是{/i}说……我们不是朋友，对吧？

lines.en: : Like...we’re both always with Ami. And we probably met that way or something. But I can’t specifically remember where-
lines.zh: : 比如……我们都总和 Ami 在一起。我们大概就是那么认识的还是什么的。可我记不清具体是在——

lines.en: : That’s exactly the thing, Maya. Ami was barely even a part of it before you {i}left.{/i} If anything, {i}she{/i} was the one who started drifting away. It was always you and me until it just...wasn’t anymore.
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿，Maya。在你{i}离开{/i}之前，Ami 根本算不上其中的一部分。要说的话，是{i}她{/i}先开始疏远的。一直都是你和我，直到突然……不再是你和我了。

lines.en: scene black
: Those are the days I miss...
lines.zh: : 那些日子才是我想念的……

lines.en: : And I want them back.
lines.zh: : 而我想把它们要回来。

lines.en: : What are-
lines.zh: : 你在干什——

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine26
: D...Do you really need to touch me for this?
lines.zh: : 你……你真的需要为了这个碰我吗？

lines.en: : Yes. It’s symbolic. I’m showing you I won’t ever let go again.
lines.zh: : 需要。这是象征。我在向你表明，我再也不会放手了。

lines.en: : I want you. I need you. And I don’t want {i}you{/i} to ever feel like you aren’t wanted or needed either when I know for a fact how hard things must be for you right now.
lines.zh: : 我想要你。我需要你。而我也不想让你觉得{i}自己{/i}不被需要、不被想要，因为我很清楚你现在有多难。

lines.en: : I’m...fine, though.
lines.zh: : 可我……没事啊。

lines.en: : You can pretend all you want, but I know that if {i}I’m{/i} handling this Niki situation poorly, it must be {i}twice{/i} as bad for you. You’ve {i}always{/i} been afraid of her. I know that much hasn’t changed.
lines.zh: : 你要装就装吧，但我知道，如果连{i}我{/i}处理 Niki 这事都处理得这么糟，那对你来说肯定糟上{i}两倍{/i}。你{i}一直{/i}都怕她。我知道这一点没变过。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine27
: That’s...I don’t really want to...
lines.zh: : 那个……我真的不太想……

lines.en: : Let’s go back to normal. {i}My{/i} normal. Not yours. The one where we secretly confide in each other and live a life that exists apart from just which one of us gets Sensei on any given day.
lines.zh: : 我们回到正轨吧。{i}我的{/i}正轨。不是你的。那个我们偷偷向彼此倾诉、过着一种不局限于"今天谁得到 Sensei"的生活的正轨。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine28

: I understand this is probably a weird and jarring thing to ask when you’ve never been that close to me from your perspective, but this is kind of how this all started in the first place. So I just need to do it again.
lines.zh: : 我明白，从你的角度看，我们从来没那么亲近，所以这请求大概又怪又突兀，但这整件事一开始就是这么开始的。所以我需要再做一次。

lines.en: : I wore you down with love and attention and annoyance and you eventually caved and let me in. So I know you’ll do it again and I know cute things like this {i}do{/i} get to you eventually.
lines.zh: : 我用爱、关注和烦人劲儿把你磨软了，你最后让步，让我进来了。所以我知道你还会再让一次，也知道这种可爱的东西最终{i}一定能{/i}打动你。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine29
: You’re just a normal teenage girl at the end of the day, aren’t you? We {i}both{/i} are...So why are we always pretending to be something bigger?
lines.zh: : 说到底，你只是个普通的少女，不是吗？我们{i}都{/i}是……那我们为什么总在假装自己是更大的东西？

lines.en: : Why can’t we just cry when we want to cry? Scream when we want to scream? Lash out and punch our pillows as we curse the world for how cruel it is to us?
lines.zh: : 为什么我们不能想哭就哭？想喊就喊？大发脾气，捶我们的枕头，咒骂这个世界对我们有多残忍？

lines.en: : I don’t want to always be strong. And that’s why I feel comfortable telling you now that I can’t do this alone anymore. I need you.
lines.zh: : 我不想永远那么坚强。所以我现在才能自在地告诉你，我再也做不了一个人了。我需要你。

lines.en: : You...have like four other girls out there already, though. Are they not enough?
lines.zh: : 可你……外面已经有四个别的女孩了啊。她们还不够吗？

lines.en: : I’d trade all of them for you. Just please don’t tell any one of them I said that.
lines.zh: : 我愿意拿她们所有人换你。只是千万别告诉她们中的任何一个我说过这话。
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Was I...was the old me really that important to you?
lines.zh: : 我……旧的我对你来说，真的那么重要吗？

lines.en: : Yes...she was. {i}You{/i} were.
lines.zh: : 是的……她很重要。{i}你{/i}很重要。

lines.en: : But I’ve...
lines.zh: : 可我……

lines.en: : I’ve never been that important to...anyone but Sensei before. I just don’t get how...things would even get to that point?
lines.zh: : 我从来没对……除了 Sensei 以外的任何人那么重要过。我只是不明白……事情怎么会走到那一步？

lines.en: : Some of the strongest bonds are formed from people experiencing terrible things together.
lines.zh: : 有些最牢固的纽带，是由共同经历过可怕事情的人结成的。

lines.en: : And even if you constantly insulted me...and teased me...and were willing to sacrifice me so long as it meant saving {i}you,{/i} it didn’t {i}matter.{/i} You were still my {i}friend.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而就算你不停地侮辱我……取笑我……只要能救{i}你自己{/i}，你愿意牺牲我，那也{i}无所谓{/i}。你依然是我的{i}朋友{/i}。

lines.en: : So please...be that again. My {i}real{/i} friend. Not just the other girl who hangs out with Ami.
lines.zh: : 所以求你了……再做回那个吧。我{i}真正{/i}的朋友。而不只是那个跟 Ami 一起混的另一个女孩。

lines.en: : She’s so fucking crazy. Like, beyond clinically insane.
lines.zh: : 她他妈的疯透了。简直是超临床意义上的疯。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine30
: Right?! And you were always the one I could talk to about that until you went poof and everything got bad! She’s so {i}creepy{/i} and I have nobody to vent to about it anymore!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！而在你"噗"地消失、一切都变糟之前，你一直是我唯一能聊这个的人！她太{i}瘆人{/i}了，现在我再也没人可倾诉了！

lines.en: : What if I’m not...as good as the Maya you remember, though?
lines.zh: : 可万一我……没有你记得的那个 Maya 那么好呢？

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine31
: What if you never wind up feeling like you can tell me anything or...what if I just never care as much as she did?
lines.zh: : 万一你永远都觉得没法跟我说任何事，或者……万一我永远都没法像她那样在乎呢？

lines.en: : Like, the only {i}good{/i} friend I’ve ever had is Ami and I literally just trashed her behind her back. Who says I won’t do the same with you?
lines.zh: : 比如，我这辈子唯一的{i}好{/i}朋友就是 Ami，而我刚刚就在背后把她骂了一通。谁说我不会对你做同样的事？

lines.en: : You probably will. And maybe this is just ignorance on my end since the last Maya may have been super jaded after an eternity of misery, but I don’t think she or {i}you{/i} ever meant or {i}mean{/i} that stuff.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}大概会。也许这只是我无知，毕竟上一个 Maya 在无尽的苦难之后可能已经极度愤世嫉俗，但我不觉得她、或者你，说那些话是{i}真心的{/i}。

lines.en: : I think you’re just as scared as me. And I think you should be allowed to feel that way instead of just suppressing it like we’ve both been doing for God-knows how long.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你跟我一样害怕。而我觉得你应该被允许有那种感觉，而不是像我们俩这样，在天知道多久的时间里一直把它压下去。

lines.en: : I am {i}struggling{/i} right now. And Sensei isn’t always there to make those feelings go away. But we can be that for each other, Maya. Salvation.
lines.zh: : 我现在很{i}挣扎{/i}。而 Sensei 并不总在身边化解那些情绪。但我们可以为彼此做到这一点，Maya。救赎。

lines.en: : That’s the gayest thing a straight girl has ever said.
lines.zh: : 这是一个直女说过的最 gay 的一句话。

lines.en: : I think we’re supposed to kiss now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们该接吻了。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine32
: You really...won’t mind me?...
lines.zh: : 你真的……不介意我吗？……

lines.en: : Because I...doubt I’ll ever change. And I doubt I’ll be even...half the person you need or want me to be. But I...
lines.zh: : 因为我……怀疑自己永远不会改变。也怀疑我连你需要的、想要的那个人的一半都达不到。但我……

lines.en: : I {i}am...{/i}lonely. And scared. And sad.
lines.zh: : 我{i}很……{/i}孤独。害怕。难过。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : I’m so fucking sad...
lines.zh: : 我他妈的太难过了……

lines.en: : {i}I know..{/i}
scene mayaeveryoneshrine33
: Why did it have to be her?...
lines.zh: : 为什么非得是她呢？……

lines.en: : What are we supposed to fucking do now?...
lines.zh: : 我们现在他妈的该怎么办？……

lines.en: : Cry...
: We’ll cry and cry and cry until we run out of things to cry about. Then we’ll pick ourselves up and keep fighting to get out of here. To a world where we won’t have to do this anymore.
lines.zh: : 我们会哭啊哭，哭到没有东西可哭为止。然后我们会重新站起来，继续为离开这里而战。去一个我们再也不必做这些事的世界。

lines.en: : Does a place like that really exist?...
lines.zh: : 那样的地方真的存在吗？……

lines.en: : Is there somewhere out there for girls like us?...
lines.zh: : 这世上某个地方，有容得下我们这样的女孩的地方吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: scene black
: But I believe that...
lines.zh: : 但我相信……

lines.en: : I believe that one day, there will be a place for everyone.
lines.zh: : 我相信，总有一天，会有一个容得下所有人的地方。

lines.en: : And that it’s somewhere we’ll never find if we’re just stuck in here...
lines.zh: : 而那是我们只要困在这儿就永远找不到的地方……

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine34
: Okay. It’s been thirty minutes. I’m getting out of here.
lines.zh: : 好了。都三十分钟了。我要走了。

lines.en: : I’ll be at Saizeriya if anybody needs me for some fucking reason.
lines.zh: : 要是谁因为什么fucking理由需要我，我在 Saizeriya。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine35
: Okay. Thanks for coming, Yumi. Ayane’s not here to say it, but we both thank you for actually making somewhat of an effort to-
lines.zh: : 好的。谢谢你来，Yumi。Ayane 不在，没法亲口说，但我们俩都谢谢你确实稍微努了点力——

lines.en: : {i}Bite me. I’m gonna have fun burning this stupid dress.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}咬我啊。我要开心地把这条蠢裙子烧掉。{/i}

lines.en: : They’re totally doing it, right? No two girls can look at each other like that, disappear for thirty minutes, then come back sexually unsatisfied. It’s impossible.
lines.zh: : 她们两个肯定在干那事儿吧？没有两个女孩能那样看着对方、消失三十分钟，然后性方面还毫无满足地回来。不可能。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine36
: I don’t know how many times I need to tell you Ayane is straight until you believe it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道要说多少次你才会相信 Ayane 是直的。

lines.en: : I can hear it over and over again but she acts even gayer than I do sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我可以听上一千遍，可她有时候表现得比我还 gay。

lines.en: : The longer I remain in this dress, the more I start to believe it is fusing to my skin.
lines.zh: : 我穿这条裙子越久，就越开始相信它正在和我的皮肤融在一起。

lines.en: scene mayaeveryoneshrine37
: Okay. How about we just call it for today, then?
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我们今天就到这儿？

lines.en: scene black
: Already? But we haven’t even done anything. I thought this was supposed to be our Rooftop Apocalypse Squad orientation?
lines.zh: : 已经？可我们什么都还没干呢。我还以为这是我们的"天台末日小队"入队仪式？

lines.en: : We’ll push orientation back until the next beach trip. I think Ayane’s tackling a more important mission at the moment.
lines.zh: : 我们把仪式推迟到下次海边之行吧。我觉得 Ayane 此刻正在执行一项更重要的任务。

lines.en: : It better be sexual. I ship those two {i}hard.{/i}
lines.zh: : 最好跟性有关。我磕她俩磕得可{i}凶{/i}了。

lines.en: : Who do you ship me with?
lines.zh: : 那你磕我和谁？

lines.en: : Makoto, obviously.
lines.zh: : Makoto，显而易见。

lines.en: : Ugh.
: Nice.
lines.zh: : 不错。

lines.en: : You’re both smart. You both wear glasses. And you’re both girls.
lines.zh: : 你们俩都聪明。你们俩都戴眼镜。而且你们俩都是女生。

lines.en: : That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这？

lines.en: : I’m easy to please. What can I say?
lines.zh: : 我很容易满足。我能说什么呢。

lines.en: : I suppose I’ll try to catch up with Yumi since we’re leaving. Are you two coming along?
lines.zh: : 既然要走了，我想去追 Yumi。你们俩一起吗？

lines.en: : Count me in. I’m friggin’ starving.
lines.zh: : 算我一个。我快饿死了。

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: : I have something else to do, unfortunately. But thank you for the invitation.
lines.zh: : 可惜我还有别的事要做。不过谢谢你的邀请。

lines.en: : Suit yourself. Come on, Uta.
lines.zh: : 随你。走吧，Uta。

lines.en: : Aye, aye, Captain Makoto! Or shall I say — Nodoka’s future wife?
lines.zh: : 遵命，Makoto 船长！或者我该说——Nodoka 未来的老婆？

lines.en: : You shan’t. Ever again, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 你不该。而且以后永远都不该。

lines.en: When the clock strikes twelve, on gazing up, reflection matters slightly;
lines.zh: 钟敲十二下时，抬头仰望，倒影也略有意义；

lines.en: Some tell you it’s the journey scribing meaning to the plot.
lines.zh: 有人告诉你，是旅程为情节写下了意义。

lines.en: I’ve been here since rather early. I can tell you that it’s not.
lines.zh: 我很早便在此处。我可以告诉你，并非如此。

lines.en: ‘Tis the hands, you see. In lifting them, I change the present nightly.
lines.zh: 是那指针，你瞧。举起它们，我便每夜改变当下。

lines.en: How dull it is existing in a world that shines so brightly.
lines.zh: 活在如此明亮的世界里，何其乏味。
